units.source_text: 这夫人平素并不同她亲睦，此次因欲劝诱她同赴筑紫，置备了几件衣服来送给她。

en.t: This lady had never been especially close to her, but this time, hoping to persuade her to go with her to Tsukushi, she had prepared several garments and brought them as gifts.

units.source_text: 此时乘坐一辆华丽的牛车，满面春风，无忧无虑，突如其来地上门了。

en.t: Now she arrived without warning in a splendid ox carriage, beaming and carefree.

units.source_text: 她叫开门，一看，四周荒芜零落，无限凄凉。

en.t: She had the gate opened, and when she looked around, everything was desolate and fallen into ruin, unbearably bleak.

units.source_text: 左右两扇门都已坍损，夫人的车夫帮着那阍人，乱了一阵，好容易打开。

en.t: Both leaves of the gate had already collapsed and decayed, and the lady's carriage men helped the gatekeeper struggle with them for some time before they finally got them open.

units.source_text: 这住屋虽然荒凉，想来总有人足踏开的三径。

en.t: Though the residence was deserted, one would have expected at least a few paths to have been worn open by people's footsteps.

units.source_text: 但这里乱草丛生，很难寻找路径。

en.t: But here the wild grass grew thick and tangled, making it very hard to find a way through.

units.source_text: 好容易找到一所向南开窗的屋子，便把车子靠到廊前。

en.t: At last they found a room with windows facing south and drew the carriage up beside the veranda.

units.source_text: 末摘花闻讯，心念这等行为太不礼貌了。

en.t: When Suetsumuhana heard of this, she thought such behavior was terribly impolite.

units.source_text: 只得把煤烟熏得污秽不堪的帷屏张起来，自己坐在帷屏后面，叫侍从出去应对。

en.t: She had no choice but to put up a screen blackened and filthy with soot, sit behind it herself, and send an attendant out to receive the visitor.
